capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 100 kWh gross (Porsche press kits for Macan 4, Turbo, GTS). Porsche pages for the Macan 4, Turbo and GTS give the same pack; same hardware assumed for this trim.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Usable 95 kWh (InsideEVs also says 95; Porsche: "up to 95 kWh of its gross energy capacity ... actively used"). Porsche pages for the Macan 4, Turbo and GTS give the same pack; same hardware assumed for this trim.

preconditioning.notes: Porsche UK support page for Cayenne Electric from MY2026: "the high-voltage battery is preconditioned automatically during active route guidance" via the Charging Planner. UK page, not a North American one; Porsche US names Cayenne preconditioning only in the Track-mode context.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Up to 270 kW at 800 V (135 kW at 400 V). Porsche pages for the Macan 4, Turbo and GTS give the same pack; same hardware assumed for this trim.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: About 21 minutes 10-80% at a suitable station. Porsche pages for the Macan 4, Turbo and GTS give the same pack; same hardware assumed for this trim.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: US on-board charger 9.6 kW (InsideEVs 2024 Macan 4/Turbo). Europe 11 kW standard (Porsche press kit), 22 kW option/standard from the new model year in Germany (electrive, Aug 2026). Same US hardware assumed for this trim/year and for Canada.
